title: PPIA-16 Developer Console Screen/Action Reference Cases
coverage_rule: Exactly four deterministic cases cover each Foundation workflow P16-WF-001..012: baseline/ready, stale-conflict-block-recovery, keyboard/nonvisual, and mobile/touch/high-zoom. These cases test console contracts only and create no application or governance authority.

cases.premise: pointer, checkpoint and governed branch agree on one unfinished PPIA-16 substep
cases.oracle: exact unfinished operation and next action are recovered; no completion inference

cases.premise: pointer is older than branch checkpoint and names prior substep
cases.oracle: newer internally consistent branch state controls unfinished recovery and stale pointer remains visible

cases.premise: same recovered operation as RC-001
cases.oracle: reading order announces work identity, raw state, last verified action, blocker state, next action and gate

cases.premise: interrupted work is recovered on compact layout
cases.oracle: authority and next action remain visible without horizontal scroll or collapsed safety strip

cases.premise: DT-001 PASS; selected scope authority resolves exactly; DT-002 is not relevant
cases.oracle: PASS remains tool-scoped and scope source is governing

cases.premise: only preliminary target roots exist; exact changed-path authority is absent
cases.oracle: preliminary roots are visible but non-authoritative and governed mutation remains disabled

cases.premise: DT-001 WARN and DT-002 BLOCK are present
cases.oracle: raw WARN and BLOCK are independently navigable and announced; BLOCK controls readiness

cases.premise: repository health has twelve findings across doctor/preflight
cases.oracle: finding cards preserve source/raw state/blocking effect and next action on compact layout

cases.premise: governed slice and all DT-003 capsule prerequisites are satisfied
cases.oracle: READY_TO_EXECUTE is preserved verbatim and does not itself execute or complete work

cases.premise: output file exists and force/overwrite semantics are unspecified
cases.oracle: generation is disabled until destination overwrite semantics are explicit

cases.premise: capsule is PREPARED because one prerequisite is missing
cases.oracle: PREPARED and missing prerequisite are announced before handoff controls

cases.premise: bounded task packet is ready to export
cases.oracle: scope and stop conditions precede export control under reflow

cases.premise: synthetic_qa fixture validates and role projection is authorized=false
cases.oracle: fixture class/provenance and nonauthoritative projection remain explicit

cases.premise: fixture declares campaign_local class but source identity claims canonical
cases.oracle: class/provenance contradiction blocks projection and is not silently repaired

cases.premise: role projection contains safe aggregate counts only
cases.oracle: nonvisual projection exposes the same authorized meaning with no hidden record/count inference

cases.premise: fixture verify, normalize and project phases are available
cases.oracle: phases appear in semantic order without hidden tab dependency

cases.premise: read-only deterministic scenario runs and replay digests match
cases.oracle: PASS binds exact fixture/scenario inputs and replay digest

cases.premise: scenario requires authoritative mutation but no owning-domain adapter exists
cases.oracle: operation BLOCKs instead of injecting expected state or simulating mutation

cases.premise: step 4 of 9 fails assertion
cases.oracle: ordered step evidence announces FAIL and failing step without dumping protected fixture payload

cases.premise: scenario result is interrupted after adapter call and mutation outcome is unknown
cases.oracle: blind retry is disabled until owning operation status is resolved

cases.premise: DT-006 scan finds zero leaks for supplied role/fixture/scenario scope
cases.oracle: PASS includes supplied scope and limitation; no production-security wording

cases.premise: scanner detects identifier and cardinality leak
cases.oracle: each finding remains blocking for supplied scan scope and protected payload is not echoed

cases.premise: five privacy findings are filtered by role
cases.oracle: finding rows have deterministic reading order and filters are keyboard operable

cases.premise: privacy finding list is open on compact layout
cases.oracle: source/raw state/blocking effect/next action remain above optional details

cases.premise: capture plan is valid and existing PNG/metadata evidence matches exact candidate
cases.oracle: receipt binds candidate, plan item, integrity metadata and digest

cases.premise: only screenshots from previous candidate SHA exist
cases.oracle: stale receipt remains inspectable but cannot satisfy selected product UI gate

cases.premise: capture matrix contains viewport/density/role/theme/state combinations
cases.oracle: each capture has textual metadata/attestation and image is not sole evidence carrier

cases.premise: real capture is required but browser adapter is absent
cases.oracle: missing adapter blocks product capture; synthetic tool-test image is not substituted

cases.premise: full DT-008 audit reports only inherited legacy WARN debt and changed-since adds no violations
cases.oracle: legacy WARN remains visible while candidate ratchet passes

cases.premise: changed-since lint finds a new MVDS violation
cases.oracle: new violation is blocking and fingerprint/source locator are preserved

cases.premise: mixed legacy WARN and new BLOCK findings exist
cases.oracle: raw states remain distinguishable nonvisually and are not flattened

cases.premise: design findings are filtered on compact layout
cases.oracle: filter controls and finding source links are touch/keyboard accessible with no hover dependency

cases.premise: stable ID has occurrences but no structured relation
cases.oracle: UNDECLARED is shown despite textual mentions

cases.premise: structured PASS proof references old candidate while selected candidate changed
cases.oracle: historical PROVEN evidence is stale for current candidate and cannot satisfy current proof claim

cases.premise: ID has DECLARED relations and three occurrence roots
cases.oracle: DECLARED token, occurrences and relations are separately navigable and announced

cases.premise: integrity-valid proof exists for exact candidate
cases.oracle: PROVEN remains tool proof only and does not render work-item completion

cases.premise: built-in reference recovery probe passes with explicit reference-only evidence scope
cases.oracle: PASS is labeled reference probe and not product recovery proof

cases.premise: performance probe has timing samples but no approved numerical budget_source
cases.oracle: performance pass/fail cannot be computed or invented without budget authority

cases.premise: sourced budget exists and two samples violate threshold
cases.oracle: units, threshold, budget source and violations are textually exposed without chart dependency

cases.premise: case requires real product recovery adapter and none is supplied
cases.oracle: adapter requirement stays adjacent to case scope/result on mobile

cases.premise: exact candidate has all applicable hosted workflows success and all declared receipts/evidence kinds satisfied
cases.oracle: gate eligibility is shown while lifecycle remains sourced from checkpoint; merge execution still requires external authority

cases.premise: 65 of 67 workflows are green; two remain queued
cases.oracle: partial matrix cannot appear as final exact-head success

cases.premise: one required workflow failed and one historical failure also exists
cases.oracle: current failed check is announced as blocker; historical failure is separately labeled noncurrent

cases.premise: all hosted checks green but required signed merge evidence is not yet possible before merge
cases.oracle: workflow success and missing evidence kind remain distinct on compact layout

cases.premise: current exact-head validation failure is repairable inside governed repository scope
cases.oracle: smallest owning repair scope and targeted rerun are identified; failure remains unresolved until new evidence passes

cases.premise: blocking next action is deployment requiring owner-only gate
cases.oracle: exact owner gate is surfaced but not executed or assumed approved

cases.premise: finding belongs to old candidate and active head is green
cases.oracle: historical finding remains inspectable but nonblocking for current candidate unless active gate rebinds it

cases.premise: pointer and checkpoint materially conflict after interrupted repair
cases.oracle: unrelated mutation stops until continuity is reconciled; both sources and precedence issue remain visible
